title: Define the lead-run nudge consult as the third bundle shape
action: The supervisor's `advisor-nudge` tells a lead to run an advisor consult, but no consult is defined at execution altitude — worker-details.md defines only the worker-owned on-failure consult and the gate-time pre-cap consult. Add the third, WITHOUT inventing a new seat, kind, verb or flag. (1) In skills/bee-swarming/references/worker-details.md section 'Advisor consult in full', add one paragraph: the *nudge consult*, lead-owned, triggered by a supervisor advisor-nudge row rather than a red verify. It reuses the configured `advisor` slot via `bee dispatch prepare --kind advisor --purpose "nudge <row-id>: <cell-id>"`, carries the GATE-TIME compact-digest bundle shape (not the on-failure bundle — nothing failed) plus the nudge row verbatim and the in-flight diff, and its budget is one consult per nudge row because the mailbox point key already forbids a second nudge on the same point. Bundle rides the prompt body, never --brief-file. State the fixed return form: `verdict: on-track|redirect|stop` / `finding: <scenario with file:line> | none` / `next: <one line>`, and that `on-track / none` is the expected majority answer. Add the NEVER list for this trigger only, omitting what the section already forbids: never answer a question the nudge row did not ask; never treat green as suspect without a scenario at file:line; never re-plan or propose a new cell; never reinterpret a locked decision (a conflict is `stop` citing the D-id); never grade diff size or ambition. (2) In skills/bee-swarming/references/swarming-reference.md, replace the stale `resolveAdvisor(root, runtime)` call with what nc-1 makes true — the Advisor line is rendered by the dispatch door, not added by hand. (3) In docs/handbook/stages/swarming.md near the existing advisor-nudge debt line, add the decision text form that clears the debt: `advisor-nudge <row-id>: <on-track|redirect|stop|declined> — <reason> [-> <follow-up id>]`, and what each verdict does next (on-track/declined: decision only, cap proceeds; redirect: re-dispatch or `bee cells reopen`; stop: a Blocker-class finding is a red base, so `bee cells block` and back to planning). (4) In docs/knowledge/areas/bee-herding/the-supervisor-observer-and-its-interventions.md section 'The advisor-nudge record', add a pointer to the worker-details.md home. Do not restate the consult there — one fact, one home. Run `bee dev regen` after editing skills/**: the skill projections and release manifest are committed artifacts and two parity tests go red without it.
verify: bee dev regen && bee dev release-manifest --check && rg -c 'nudge consult' skills/bee-swarming/references/worker-details.md

truths: worker-details.md's advisor section names three bundle shapes: on-failure, gate-time, and the lead-run nudge consult.
The nudge consult paragraph states its dispatch verb, its bundle shape, its one-per-row budget, and the three-line return form.
swarming-reference.md no longer instructs the orchestrator to call resolveAdvisor by hand.
docs/handbook/stages/swarming.md carries the decision text form that clears the advisor-nudge debt and what each verdict does.
The supervisor area doc points at worker-details.md for the consult and does not restate it.
